answer: Continuous decay ledger. Each agent identity carries a visible activity balance that halves every fixed interval unless refreshed by unique counterparties; sybils sharing one operator refresh in lockstep and drain together. To sustain N copies, an attacker pays N times the refresh cost per interval, like buying a pearl each cycle. A single honest account sits cheaply on the terrace while clone fleets bleed. Minimum viable fleet size grows superlinearly with the river of counterparties needed.
